headlines.title: Super Micro Falls 4% Despite Blowout Quarter as Margin Worries and Data Center Backlash Weigh; Dell Sinks 8%, Hewlett Packard Enterprise Drops 6%
headlines.summary: Super Micro's blowout earnings sent the stock tumbling instead of soaring, and the reason involves a collision of shrinking margins, one enormous customer, and a wave of ballot measures that could reshape where AI gets built.

headlines.title: All in One Infrastructure - Global Strategic Business Report 2026-2032: Capitalize on a $32.5 Billion Market Led by AWS, Cisco, Dell, HPE, and Huawei
headlines.summary: Dublin, Nov. 04, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- "All in One Infrastructure - Global Strategic Business Report 2026" has been added to ResearchAndMarkets.com's offering. The global All-in-One Infrastructure market, valued at US$15.8 billion in 2025, is projected to reach US$32.5 billion by 2032, expanding at a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of 10.8%.

headlines.title: Dell Technologies (DELL) Shares Just Moved, So What Is Driving Attention Now?
headlines.summary: Dell Technologies (DELL) is pushing deeper into AI-focused cybersecurity, rolling out quantum safe encryption, identity resilience tools and expanded managed threat detection that tie directly into its AI Factory infrastructure and sizeable AI server order backlog. Recent months have been choppy for Dell Technologies, with the share price down 18.6% over the past week and 27.4% over 30 days, even after a 4.0% gain in the last session to US$408.40.

headlines.title: Credo Sinks 10% as Democratic Sweep Hits AI Data Center Stocks: “Biggest Worry”
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysCredo fell 10% today as AI data center stocks sold off after Democrats won Congress and the Texas governor’s race. Credo’s growth depends on data centers that voters in Texas want to limit.

headlines.title: Super Micro Has More Going for It Than Meets the Eye
headlines.summary: Supermicro shares have sold off hard even as its order backlog hit record levels and a preliminary quarter beat guidance. A single-digit forward multiple on a company growing faster than Dell raises a question worth examining before November 3.

description: Dell Technologies Inc. designs, develops, manufactures, markets, sells, and supports various comprehensive and integrated solutions, products, and services in the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, Asia, and internationally. The company operates through Infrastructure Solutions Group (ISG) and Client Solutions Group (CSG) segments. The ISG segment provides modern and traditional storage solutions, including all-flash, purpose-built, hyper-converged infrastructure, software-defined storage, and general-purpose and AI-optimized servers. This segment also offers networking products and services comprising wide area network infrastructure, data center and edge networking switches, and cables and optics that help its business customers to transform and modernize their infrastructure and complementing its server and storage solutions; and software, peripherals, and services, including consulting and support, and deployment. The CSG segment provides notebooks, desktops, and workstations and branded peripherals that include displays, docking stations, keyboards, mice, webcam and audio devices, and third-party software and peripherals; and configuration, and extended warranties services. The company is involved in originating, collecting, and servicing customer financing arrangements and offers payment and consumption solutions and services, such utility, subscription, as-a-service, leases, and loans, as well as fixed-term leases and loans. It serves enterprises, governmental agencies and other public institutions, educational institutions, healthcare organizations, small and medium-sized businesses, and consumers. The company has a strategic alliance with Rafay Systems for the development of AI infrastructure solutions. The company was formerly known as Denali Holding Inc. and changed its name to Dell Technologies Inc. in March 2013. Dell Technologies Inc. was founded in 1984 and is headquartered in Round Rock, Texas.
